name: Flavio Cobolli
intro: Flavio Cobolli is an Italian player who lives in Rome. He reached the French Open final this year. He is ranked number 6 in the world.
story: As a kid, Flavio played soccer for the famous club AS Roma. At 14 he had to choose: soccer or tennis. He picked tennis! His dad Stefano was a tennis pro, and now he is Flavio's coach. Flavio also helped Italy win the Davis Cup team trophy in 2025.

funFacts.text: He owns all three of Roma's soccer jerseys. His favorite is the white one.
He has about 30 tattoos. One is Roma's wolf logo.
He loves fashion and likes wearing big, comfy oversized clothes.
His nickname on one tour is The Gladiator, like in ancient Rome.
His tennis idol is Novak Djokovic.
He won the French Open junior doubles title in 2020.
He has been best friends with tennis star Lorenzo Musetti since they were kids.

watchFor: Watch his speedy soccer-player footwork as he races around the court.

notes: Birth 2002-05-06 Florence, resides Rome, R-handed/2HBH, 183 cm, father Stefano ex-player and coach, brother Guglielmo, idol Djokovic, 2020 RG boys' doubles with Stricker, 2025 Davis Cup, 2026 RG finalist, No. 6: confirmed on Wikipedia.
